v.title: Messi’s MLS Misfire: Inter Miami’s Playoff Panic
v.excerpt: Messi’s late strike fails to save Inter Miami as Columbus Crew snatches a 2‑1 playoff win, highlighting the limits of star power alone.
v.body:
## Quick take
Inter Miami’s MLS Cup playoff clash against Columbus Crew collapsed into a 2‑1 defeat, with Messi’s late strike proving a cruel reminder that even superstar brilliance can’t singlehandedly lift a team.

## What happened
The match began with Columbus asserting control, capitalising on a swift counter after a Miami error. Inter’s early threat came from a well‑crafted set‑piece, but the defense faltered, allowing Columbus to equalise with a header from a corner. In the dying minutes, Messi found the back of the net, but the goal was disallowed for an off‑side offence, sealing the loss.

In the aftermath, Inter Miami’s bench erupted in frustration. The coaching staff hinted at tactical adjustments, while fans voiced concerns over the team’s consistency. Columbus Crew, meanwhile, celebrated a historic playoff run, signalling a new era for the franchise.

## Why it matters
- **Messi’s Form & Future**: The disallowed goal underscores Messi’s continued importance to Inter Miami, yet the team’s inability to convert chances raises questions about his impact on a squad still finding its rhythm.
- **Barça’s Transfer Window Insight**: Barcelona’s own search for a creative talisman mirrors Inter Miami’s plight; the club must evaluate whether to invest in a proven star or nurture homegrown talent to avoid reliance on a single player.
- **MLS Cup Dynamics**: Columbus’s victory demonstrates that MLS playoffs reward depth and composure over star power alone, a lesson for any European club eyeing a future MLS venture.

## What's next
Watch Inter Miami’s next fixture against the LA Galaxy. The coaching staff will likely test a more balanced midfield, perhaps integrating a younger playmaker to relieve pressure on Messi. Meanwhile, Columbus will look to carry the momentum into the final, potentially reshaping their roster strategy for the next season.
